items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Zoot Sims as a 'big white superstar in jazz' alongside Chet Baker and Stan Getz, but the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond with any personal anecdote, collaboration, or direct interaction with Zoot Sims.

ctx.x: Chet Baker and he was a great white hope, singing and playing the trumpet. You got your great Stan Getz. He was your next great white hope, you see. People like Zoot Sims, you know he was mentioned but he wasn't a big star like those guys was, you know. Who else? Like I say, you can count those guys, those white guys on your one hand. Those were your big white superstars in jazz, Bob Brookmeyer, he was mentioned but he wasn't a superstar.
